title: Singing in the Dark
themeTags: God is with you in the dark
reflectionQuestion: Paul and Silas sang to God even in a dark prison, and they were not alone. I wonder what song or prayer you could turn to when something feels dark or scary?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, Acts 16). Toward-100. WATCH-ITEM: the arrest/beating kept ABSTRACT ('some people did not like what they were saying... put into prison'); no violence dwelt on (the jailer 'washed their hurts' is the only gentle nod). The HEART = they SANG in the dark at midnight (joy/praise even in hard, scary places); the earthquake opens the doors + chains fall; they DON'T run; the jailer is kept SAFE and becomes a friend (whole family). Room = God is with you in the dark / you are never alone / you can always find a song. Ties the not-alone thread. Soft close ('song'). VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL_C_VINCENT (pastoral, hope-in-hard-places).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
